reason: My site has had the wrong prices for years and the regulars still come, and the Glovo people see the menu on Glovo anyway. 25 euro every month, 300 a year, for a thing I already forget exists is hard for me to justify.
objection: I don't trust a robot to touch my prices. If it writes 2.30 instead of 3.20 and a customer shows me the phone, I lose money or I look like a cheat, and I am too busy behind the counter to check every message it sends back.
would_change_my_mind: If it also fixed my Google page and Glovo menu from the same message, and someone I know with a café showed me it working for a few months without mistakes, maybe I try the 15 euro plan.
